steps.name: InitCycle
steps.function: timer(trun := MUL_T_AI(SELF_ACT_PULSE,2 * SELF_ACT_CYCLES), toff := SELF_ACT_TIME, Test := TEST, ARE := ARE, arx := ARX); ARX := timer.ARX; ARO := timer.ARO;

steps.name: Branch_0
steps.function: pwgen(PTL := SELF_ACT_PULSE, PTH := SELF_ACT_PULSE); out := pwgen.Q;

steps.name: Step_255
steps.function: pwgen.PTH := (CYCLE_TIME * BYTE_TO_TIME(BAND_B(IN,SENS)) ) / BYTE_TO_TIME(BYTE#255); pwgen.PTL := CYCLE_TIME - pwgen.PTH; pwgen(); out := pwgen.Q;

transitions.guard: aro == FALSE AND NOT (in<sens) AND NOT (BYTE_TO_USINT(in)>USINT#255-BYTE_TO_USINT(sens))
aro == FALSE AND NOT (in<sens) AND NOT (BYTE_TO_USINT(in)>USINT#255-BYTE_TO_USINT(sens))

nl_prompt:
When: Safety-critical input IN or SENS is missing, out of bounds, or invalid before processing
Action: Add SafetyCheckInput step after InitCycle that validates IN and SENS are within valid BYTE range (0-255) and SENS is not zero. If validation fails, transition to SafetyError step that halts output and sets error flag. If validation passes, continue to existing branching logic.

When: Actuation timer in InitCycle exceeds maximum safe time limit indicating potential runaway condition
Action: Add timeout monitoring in InitCycle by tracking elapsed cycles. If ARO remains active beyond SELF_ACT_CYCLES safety threshold multiplied by a safety factor, transition to TimeoutSafeStop step that forces output low, sets timeout error flag, and requires manual reset before resuming.

steps.name: InitCycle
steps.function: timer(trun := MUL_T_AI(SELF_ACT_PULSE,2 * SELF_ACT_CYCLES), toff := SELF_ACT_TIME, Test := TEST, ARE := ARE, arx := ARX); ARX := timer.ARX; ARO := timer.ARO; SafetyCycleCounter := SafetyCycleCounter + 1;

steps.name: SafetyCheckInput
steps.function: InputValidFlag := (IN >= BYTE#0) AND (IN <= BYTE#255) AND (SENS > BYTE#0) AND (SENS <= BYTE#255); SafetyErrorFlag := NOT InputValidFlag;

steps.name: SafetyError
steps.function: out := FALSE; SafetyErrorActive := TRUE; ARO := FALSE;

steps.name: TimeoutSafeStop
steps.function: out := FALSE; TimeoutErrorFlag := TRUE; ARO := FALSE; SafetyCycleCounter := 0;

steps.name: Branch_0
steps.function: pwgen(PTL := SELF_ACT_PULSE, PTH := SELF_ACT_PULSE); out := pwgen.Q;

steps.name: Step_255
steps.function: pwgen.PTH := (CYCLE_TIME * BYTE_TO_TIME(BAND_B(IN,SENS)) ) / BYTE_TO_TIME(BYTE#255); pwgen.PTL := CYCLE_TIME - pwgen.PTH; pwgen(); out := pwgen.Q;

transitions.guard: SafetyErrorFlag == FALSE AND SafetyCycleCounter <= (SELF_ACT_CYCLES * 3) AND aro == TRUE
SafetyErrorFlag == FALSE AND SafetyCycleCounter <= (SELF_ACT_CYCLES * 3) AND aro == FALSE AND in<sens
SafetyErrorFlag == FALSE AND SafetyCycleCounter <= (SELF_ACT_CYCLES * 3) AND aro == FALSE AND NOT (in<sens) AND BYTE_TO_USINT(in)>USINT#255-BYTE_TO_USINT(sens)
SafetyErrorFlag == FALSE AND SafetyCycleCounter <= (SELF_ACT_CYCLES * 3) AND aro == FALSE AND NOT (in<sens) AND NOT (BYTE_TO_USINT(in)>USINT#255-BYTE_TO_USINT(sens))
